column3: NKJV has “our life,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “your life.”
NKJV has “even as Christ forgave you,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “as the Lord forgave you.”
NKJV has “the peace of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the peace of Christ.”
NKJV has “to the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to God.”
NKJV has “fearing God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “fearing the Lord.”
